passages.provision_quote: This act does not create or recognize a right to an abortion and does not make lawful an abortion that is currently unlawful.
passages.note: SB1457 bans sex-, race- and genetic-abnormality-based abortions and disclaims any right to abortion; it sets no gestational limit.
Bill overview lists Petersen as a co-sponsor of SB1457, signed into law April 27, 2021.
Senate final-reading roll call shows Petersen voting Y to pass SB1457.

rows.reasoning: SB1457 bans abortion sought for the sex, race, or a genetic abnormality of the child, and its construction clause disclaims any right to abortion or legalization of any abortion now unlawful; it sets no gestational limit and no stage-based exception rule, so it is a narrow, reason-based restriction that does not address when abortion is legal. It is adjacent on every passage, so no chair survives.
